statements.text: Proteins are food components needed for muscle building, proper growth, and development.
Boiled eggs and rajma cannot supply proteins because only sweets build muscle.
Any tiny amount of protein is enough for a growing child on a long trek.

stem: Bilal packs boiled eggs and rajma for a long school trek. His aunt says these foods supply proteins that help build muscle and support proper growth and development.

teacher.key_rationale: Proteins support muscle building and growth; eggs and rajma are protein sources. Sweets are not the only muscle food, and any tiny amount is not enough for growing children.
